name: Una
shortFact: The industrious gateway to spiritual shrines.
description: Una is a land of pilgrimage and agrarian industriousness situated in the fertile Shivalik foothills.
history: Una was historically part of the ancient Katoch kingdom of Kangra. The Jaswan State, the first offshoot of Kangra, was founded in 1170 A.D. by Raja Purab Chand with its capital at Rajpura. It eventually came under Mughal and then Sikh rule before being annexed by Maharaja Ranjit Singh in 1815. Before 1966, Una was a tehsil of the Hoshiarpur district in Punjab. It is also the ancestral home of the Bedis, the direct descendants of Guru Nanak Dev, the founder of Sikhism.
culture: Una is a major site for spiritual tourism, centered around the Chintpurni Shakti Peeth—where the forehead of Goddess Sati is believed to have fallen. The culture is a unique synthesis of Punjabi agrarian energy and Himachali hill traditions. Fairs like Pir Nigaha and the annual Chintpurni Mela attract millions. The people are known for their hospitality and deep-rooted devotion to both Hindu and Sikh traditions.

topSpots.name: Chintpurni Temple
topSpots.description: One of the 51 Shakti Peethas in India, a major pilgrimage destination for devotees from across the country.

topSpots.name: Bhakra Dam
topSpots.description: A monumental high gravity dam on the Sutlej river, once the highest of its kind in the world.

topSpots.name: Una Fort
topSpots.description: The historical fort and home of the Bedi family, descendants of Guru Nanak Dev.

topSpots.name: Gobind Sagar Lake
topSpots.description: The massive backwaters of the Bhakra Dam, named after Guru Gobind Singh.

cuisine.name: Chintpurni Prasad & Punjabi Flavors
cuisine.description: A mix of traditional temple prasad and the hearty, robust flavors of Punjabi agrarian life.
cuisine.history: Una's location on the border of Punjab has created a rich culinary exchange, blending local hill pulses with Punjabi breads.
cuisine.tip: Don't miss the langar (community meal) served at the major shrines in the district.

wildlife.name: Indian Leopard
wildlife.description: A versatile predator that roams the hilly terrain of the Shivalik foothills in Una.
